# Commands

Describing a program to start: its arguments, environment, working directory and standard streams.

<h2 id="stdio"><code>Stdio</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum Stdio: uint8 {
    Inherit = 0,
    Null = 1,
    Pipe = 2
}
```

What a child's standard stream is connected to. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Process/Src/Command.rux#L46)

**Cases**

| Name      | Value | Description                                                                                     |
| --------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Inherit` | `0`   | The stream this process has, which the child shares.                                            |
| `Null`    | `1`   | Nothing: reads find the end at once and writes are discarded.                                   |
| `Pipe`    | `2`   | A new pipe, whose other end the parent takes from the [`Child`](/docs/api/process/child#child). |

<h2 id="command"><code>Command</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Command {
    // private fields
}
```

A program to start, with its arguments, working directory, environment changes and standard streams.
Build it up and then [`Spawn`](/docs/api/process/command#spawn) it, or [`Run`](/docs/api/process/command#run) it to completion, or [`Capture`](/docs/api/process/command#capture) what it writes. A command can be started
more than once. A command is not copied.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Process/Src/Command.rux#L59)

**Constructors**

<h3 id="command-new"><code>Command</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Command(
    allocator: Allocator,
    program: char8[..]
) -> Command
```

A command to start `program`, found through `PATH` when it names no directory. The program is also the child's
first argument, as every system expects. Its streams start as `Stdio::Inherit`.

| Name        | Type        | Description                               |
| ----------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the command's parts are kept in      |
| `program`   | `char8[..]` | the program's name or path, as UTF-8 text |

**Returns**: the command

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Process/Src/Command.rux#L84)

**Methods**

<h3 id="capture"><code>Capture</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Capture(
    self: &Command,
    allocator: Allocator
) -> CapturedOutput ! IoError
```

Starts the program with its output and error piped, keeps everything it writes, and waits for it to finish.
Its input is what the command says, which is this process's own unless changed.

| Name        | Type        | Description                         |
| ----------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the captured bytes are kept in |

**Returns**: the output, the error and how the program finished

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Process/Src/Command.rux#L83)

<h3 id="spawn"><code>Spawn</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Spawn(self: &Command) -> Child ! IoError
```

Starts the program as a child process.

**Returns**: the child, or fails: with a part of the command the system could not take, with `NotFound` for a
program that is not there, or with the system's reason

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Process/Src/Command.rux#L191)
